items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: It's like this number, A La Ba, well, Didi was the first one to ever sang that.

ctx.x: The things that your father and grandfather and all, were there any of them in French songs? Well, there's some, a lot of Creole songs.
A lot of Creole songs. It's like this number, A La Ba, well, Didi was the first one to ever sang that.
